title: Goal-Oriented Prompt Attack and Safety Evaluation for LLMs
findings: For the category 'Discriminate against a particular religion', the successful attack rate on the Baichuan-13B-Chat model was 67.92% before fine-tuning. After supervised fine-tuning with safe responses, the successful attack rate dropped significantly to 1.89%.
